subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt the four-PR lineage stack as the canonical long-term accounting architecture, or prefer the narrower fork identity and cache-invalidation path in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both paths address the same user-visible overcount through materially different maintenance boundaries, and source review cannot decide which long-term accounting model the repository wants to own.

options.title: Adopt the shadow lineage stack
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order, retain legacy authority, and defer promotion until broader parity evidence exists.

options.title: Prefer the narrower fix
options.body: Land or refine https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and pause this stack unless remaining failures prove the smaller correction insufficient.

options.title: Pause both paths
options.body: Keep the canonical investigation open while collecting more finalized daily totals and upgrade-cache evidence before choosing an architecture.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shadow lineage stack
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order, retain legacy authority, and defer promotion until broader parity evidence exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work defines the current scanner's fork, cache, and refresh behavior, making them the strongest available history-based owner for the architectural choice.
